description: This bar chart, titled “PHHEME” on the left and “PolitiFact” on the right, compares the accuracy percentages of a model across six different configurations for each dataset, with the vertical axis labeled “Accuracy (%)” ranging from 75.0 to 95.0 in increments of 2.5, and the horizontal axis listing the configurations: “Ours,” “w/o comments,” “w/o text,” “w/o select,” “w/o emotion,” and “w/o cognition.” For the PHHEME dataset, the “Ours” configuration achieves the highest accuracy at 89.84%, followed by “w/o comments” at 86.82%, “w/o select” at 88.80%, “w/o emotion” at 87.34%, and “w/o cognition” at 87.17%, with “w/o text” showing the lowest at 80.10%. For the PolitiFact dataset, “Ours” achieves the highest accuracy at 90.57%, followed by “w/o comments” at 85.85%, “w/o select” at 89.62%, “w/o emotion” at 84.91%, and “w/o cognition” at 87.74%, with “w/o text” showing the lowest at 83.02%. The bars are color-coded: “Ours” is dark red, “w/o comments” is orange, “w/o text” is light yellow, “w/o select” is light blue, “w/o emotion” is medium blue, and “w/o cognition” is dark blue. The bars are arranged in a single group per dataset, with no sorting or stacking, and each bar is labeled with its exact accuracy percentage value.
